dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Chenyu Vale is full of noteworthy treasures... But in my opinion, the jade and ores are the most precious.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: I stumbled upon an area rich in ores while on a stroll the other day. There were even some high-quality crystals with a brilliant blue hue amongst them...

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Qiaoying Village is in no way lacking ores right now, so feel free to take a look for any you might need...
